set.body: Real-study visual review on frozen92ca5f54 exposed a view/playback usability limit for raw exported timestamps with large origins and unknown trial extent: initial playhead0 and viewport0..max(onset+duration) compress all observed fixations near the right edge and begin with a long empty lead-in. Example synthetic unknown-extent trial: onsets600000/600500ms, durations400/300ms. Current ExploreTimeline.endMs falls back to max end; sync/Play reset to0. This is not a new inferred timing-provenance fact or a density/scoring error. Define an explicit observed-coverage viewport/playhead policy without changing stored onsets, inventing a stimulus/trial event origin or claiming unknown time calibration. Keep absolute clock labels and clear unknown-extent disclosure; preserve declared extents and half-open brushing. Add pure and headless tests for large-origin unknown extent versus declared extent. Current G2 acceptance is exploratory spatial only; this remains active v1 application hardening under C. Private source-record screenshot/review is retained locally, not uploaded.
set.title: Explore timeline: focus observed coverage for large-origin timestamps
